text:
nina: Hey @morgan @rahul PTAL — I addressed all review comments on PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842. Added a smoke script and a short perf note in the README. Left one tiny inline question about retry backoff but default behavior preserved.

rahul: Thanks — will scan in ~30m. Quick q: did you run the smoke locally? Any flakiness to flag?

nina: Ran smoke locally with `./scripts/smoke.sh --local` — passed on my laptop. I added a log snippet to the PR: ```curl -s localhost:8080/health | jq .status``` should return "ok". No flaky tests touched.

morgan: Skimmed the changes. Docs nit (wording) but not blocking. LGTM from me :+1:

nina: Awesome, thanks @morgan. I still need one more approver before merge. @rahul can you be merge custodian for this? Prefer to merge after 14:00 PST to avoid overlap with the infra migration.

rahul: I can take custody. I'll queue it for 14:15 PST. Can you add a one-line rollback note in the PR description so oncall can act quickly if needed?

nina: Done — added `rollback: revert PR #842 and re-run canary` to the PR description and updated the smoke instructions.

release-bot: reservation confirmed — canary slot reserved 2026-03-21 14:15 PST for PR #842 (owner: rahul).

rahul: Great. I'll merge once CI is green at ~14:10 and watch logs for 10m. Will post status here. @morgan please ping if you notice anything unusual during the window.

morgan: Will monitor the dashboard and alert if latency or error rate spikes.

nina: Thanks everyone — PTAL (please take a look) and appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
